Bulldozer Used for Wedding Procession Amid Demolitions

In Jaipur, a marriage garden faced demolition, with decorations removed and homes reportedly broken, leading to women crying as they witnessed the destruction. Simultaneously, in Uttar Pradesh, a groom rode a bulldozer to his wedding procession, with the bride also watching. The latter event gained traction on Google Trends, with queries asking why the groom used a bulldozer for the procession.
